crossRefs.note: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.
Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who…
His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.
He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.

translations.web: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.
translations.bsb: When my heart was grieved and I was pierced within,
translations.kjv: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.
translations.asv: For my soul was grieved, And I was pricked in my heart:
